institution.name: Zhejiang University, Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics

description_short: Zhejiang University's Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics offers Qiushi Fellow and Postdoctoral Researcher positions in pure mathematics, starting 1 September 2027 by default. Applications, with three recommendation letters, are due mid-December 2026 on MathJobs.
